function.name: image_polybackrow
function.description: Activate a MATLAB figure by handle name and apply row-wise polynomial background subtraction via the MATLAB script `image_polybackrow`.

figure_name.description: Variable name of the figure handle in the MATLAB workspace to activate.

pnum.description: Polynomial degree for background subtraction. Allowed values: '1', '2', '3'.

function.name: opensxm_auto
function.description: Load an SXM file from the given directory and delegate handling to MATLAB (initializes its own figure, no prior activation needed).

path.description: Directory path containing the SXM file.

fn.description: File name of the SXM to load (including extension).

pnum.description: Load mode selector: '1' = single forward topography, '2' = load all images, '3' = forward-only images. Default '1'.

function.name: image_Fourier_Transform
function.description: Activate a MATLAB figure by handle name and perform Fourier transform via the MATLAB script `image_Fourier_Transform`.

figure_name.description: Variable name of the target figure handle in MATLAB workspace.

pnum.description: Fourier transform mode: '1' = real, '2' = imag, '3' = amplitude, '4' = phase. Default '3'.

function.name: image_Extract_Linecut
function.description: Activate a MATLAB figure by handle name and extract linecuts via the MATLAB script `image_Extract_Linecut`.

figure_name.description: Variable name of the target figure handle in MATLAB workspace.

linecut_param.description: The parameters to extract linecut, including the start/end coordinates, average setting, etc. It should be an 1D array of 7 elements, like: [1,1,-1,0,0,0,0]
